tvShow.name: Sins and Roses
tvShow.overview: As a boy, Serhat lost both his father and fortune but built an empire on family and integrity. His world shatters when his wife Berrak hides a devastating secret and falls into a coma. While searching for answers, his heart hardens—until he meets Zeynep, a passionate florist chasing the same truth, igniting a journey of trust, passion, and redemption.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Serhat Tecer lives a happy life with his wife and daughters—until an unexpected truth turns his world upside down. The great love of his life, his wife Berrak, has been hiding a shocking secret for years: she has another child… Kader. As Serhat begins to unravel the truth, his path crosses with Zeynep—a brave and outspoken woman who becomes his greatest ally when he least expects it. Following every clue step by step, Serhat soon realizes that the key to Berrak’s mysterious, secret-laden past will emerge from the last place he could have imagined.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Zeynep teams up with Serhat's brother, Cihan Tecer, to find a clue. Meanwhile, Serhat, unaware of all this, is following his own trail. When he sees the white lily left by Berrak's bedside, he thinks he's getting close to the person he's been searching for. A little later, he learns who left the flower. What he feels is not only anger but also immense pain. Zeynep, eager for news from Cihan, discovers where Serhat has gone, but by the time she finds out, it's too late.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After confronting his brother Can, Serhat tries to uncover the truth about the past by reading the letters Berrak left behind. During this process, the only contact saved on Berrak’s phone is also revealed. As Zeynep and Serhat follow the trail Berrak left behind, they remain unaware of the evil scheme being plotted by Tülay and Erkan, or of the explosive secret that Ebru is about to unleash upon the Tecer family.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: While Serhat is devastated by what Hayal has learned, Cihan grapples with Ebru's unexpected move. New information about Berrak spurs Zeynep and Serhat into action, unaware of what Tibet has planned for them. As Serhat pursues new information, news from the hospital forces him to make a choice.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The series' plot is as follows: While the Tecer family welcomes Berrak's awakening with joy, Serhat pursues the truth hidden from him, demanding to know who Kader's father is. While Zeynep, realizing it's time for her to leave, expects Berrak to accept Kader as her daughter, Berrak makes a move that will thwart all expectations.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Kader, influenced by her mother, has returned to Tülay and Erkan. While Zeynep leaves the Tecer house and tries to get Kader back, Serhat talks to his daughters and tries to find ways to get Berrak out of the house. Meanwhile, a phone call from Can forces Serhat to make another choice.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Accused of treason, Cihan struggles to survive and wants to do Serhat one last favor: tell him who Kader's father is. Zeynep and Kader's return home disrupts Berrak's plans. While Berrak wants to strengthen her position in the house, she is unaware that Cihan is about to reveal her secret.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After Cihan's confession, Serhat appears before Tibet and beats Tibet to death, causing him to fall into a coma. Serhat, believing Tibet to be dead, wonders how he will explain this to his daughters and Zeynep. When Berrak learns that Cihan has confessed everything to Serhat, she leaves the house quickly, taking the girls with her.  Serhat and Zeynep pursue Berrak to save Hayal and İlkim. However, Zeynep and Serhat are unaware of the danger that awaits them. Berrak, however, confronts Serhat with a completely different plan.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Just as Serhat is about to confess the truth to İlkim and Hayal, accompanied by a psychologist, Berrak's arrival and her announcement that she's pregnant shock everyone. Serhat has reached the end of the road for Berrak and tells the girls the whole truth. Learning that Kader is their sister, İlkim and Hayal's lives are turned upside down, leaving Kader in tears.  Zeynep, meanwhile, is on the brink of a new opportunity opened for her by Serhat, and she takes action to fulfill her dream of becoming a teacher. Zeynep will support Serhat, both working and helping him recover from the devastation in his family. Meanwhile, Cihan continues to try every possible way to maintain his agreement with Tibet.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Berrak returns home using her pregnancy as leverage, while Serhat looks for a way to keep her away from his daughters. Wanting to repair her relationship with the girls and push both Kader and Zeynep out of her life, Berrak finally finds the solution she’s been searching for—with Tibet’s help. Left desperate, Zeynep turns to Serhat for support. Will Serhat’s move be enough to derail Berrak’s plan?

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: After Serhat's proposal, Zeynep considers the best course of action to win Kader back, while Hayal and İlkim are furious with Serhat because of the paternity test. Berrak finds a way to win his daughters over. A mistake made by Mustafa, who wants to help Azra, leads to a completely unexpected event.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Zeynep and Serhat's marriage initially disappoints the Candan family, especially Arif. While Serhat searches for the person responsible for what happened to Zeynep and Arif, Berrak, with Tülay's help, begins to speak ill of Zeynep and her family to the neighbors in their new neighborhood. An unexpected event at the hotel has consequences that deeply affect everyone.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: After the clash at the hotel, Serhat finds himself dealing with Tibet’s growing anger while also going after the illegal activities taking place in his hotel. As Zeynep and Serhat wait for the Social Services visit, the final step to taking Kader, they try to withstand the backlash against their marriage. Meanwhile, Berrak does not remain idle and takes action to take Hayal and İlkim away from Serhat.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Zeynep's refusal to tell Serhat who Azra went with causes problems between them, while Serhat is also dealing with Berrak's new moves to win İlkim over to her side. While the Tecer family investigates what happened to Cihan, Zeynep realizes that her brother knows and is hiding the fact that Ömer is the one who wounded her.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Mustafa’s lying about Ömer deeply shakes Zeynep. While Zeynep hesitates over whether or not to tell Serhat about this, Serhat is dealing with Berrak’s new moves. As the relationship between Cihan and Ebru comes to light, the news that will deeply shake Zeynep and Serhat comes from Kader.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Zeynep is devastated when Kader runs away from home. As she and Serhat try every possible way to find her, Kader grows increasingly afraid of Pelin the longer she stays with her. Meanwhile, Ebru leaves home and moves in with Cihan, while Tibet, driven by his anger toward Serhat, sets a deadly plan into motion. Zeynep and Serhat are caught completely unprepared for Tibet’s scheme.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: The voice that Serhat hears after so many years brings the three siblings together again. As he decides to forgive Cihan and bring him back to the company, Zeynep tries to understand the real plan behind this decision. Berrak looks for ways to draw Ebru to her side, using it against Zeynep. Meanwhile, a conversation that İlkim witnesses ends up triggering a terrible event.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: While İlkim fights for her life in the hospital after the accident she suffered, Serhat discovers that the person who ran over his daughter was Tibet and begins to pursue him. Zeynep tries to prevent Serhat from making a terrible mistake. With every moment he fails to find Tibet, Serhat grows even more furious, and there is only one person left he can turn to.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: As Serhat tries to learn Tibet’s whereabouts from Berrak, Zeynep begins to realize that he has been disappearing at night. When news spreads that Berrak has gone missing, Zeynep takes action to find out what Serhat has done. Meanwhile, after Pelin’s tip-off, the police set out to capture Serhat, leaving Zeynep with very little time.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Serhat tries to uncover who Nejat is based on what he learned from Berrak. At the same time, he is trying to keep Zeynep away from this dangerous business. Nejat, upon learning that Serhat is after him, sends him a message. When Serhat goes to the meeting place, he encounters something entirely unexpected.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: While Serhat takes another step closer to discovering who Nejat really is, Zeynep is busy trying to pull her scattered siblings back together. After returning home, Azra is devising a plan to gather information about Cihan, while Serhat is planning to explain his new decisions in life to his family, whom he has invited to his house. The invitation has a surprise guest.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Berrak's announcement that she will file a custody lawsuit for Kader deeply shakes Zeynep and Serhat. While Zeynep searches for a way to turn Berrak's move against her, Berrak is plotting something even more devastating. As Serhat tries to reach Nejat, he realizes he is much closer to him than he thought.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: After shooting Nejat, Serhat settles his score with him. However, Nejat doesn't stop there and tells Serhat that Kader's father isn't Tibet, so that Serhat will learn of his great betrayal. Zeynep, on the other hand, tells Serhat that she will send Berrak to prison to prevent him from marrying Kader, and she is willing to risk everything. Azra, having lost her mother, plans to run away with Mustafa. Cihan is cornered and in a state of panic. After learning that Kader's father is not Tibet, Serhat now has only one suspect: Cihan. Serhat, who discovers the truth through a plan he devised between Berrak and Cihan, is devastated. How will Serhat react when he confronts Cihan?

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: Following the devastating blow he experienced, Serhat withdraws into himself. Zeynep, meanwhile, is worried about Serhat getting into trouble. Cihan reaches the end of the road, and the whole family is shocked when they learn of Cihan's betrayal. Zeynep, fighting to prevent Berrak from taking Kader, loses her temper in court.  Serhat tells the girls that Cihan and Berrak will no longer be a part of their lives, but he doesn't explain. The girls are baffled by their father's reaction and become increasingly curious. How will Serhat move on with his life after learning of Cihan's betrayal?

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.overview: Zeynep will try everything to prevent Kader from being given to Berrak. Serhat, on the other hand, finds it difficult to control Zeynep. Azra puts even more pressure on Cihan. Zeynep completely renovates the entire house. Serhat celebrates the success of his hotel with mixed feelings.  Zeynep, unable to resist Berrak's attempt to take Kader, flees with Kader. Serhat searches everywhere for Zeynep, but finds himself in great danger. While Zeynep loses her battle to keep Kader, Serhat, using information he learned from Azra, uncovers Pelin's secret.

episodes.name: Episode 26
episodes.overview: Zeynep's departure with Kader deeply hurts Serhat. Berrak achieves her goal, and Kader is no longer with Zeynep. While a cold wind blows between Serhat and Zeynep, Kader once again helplessly surrenders to Berrak. Zeynep continues to stay with her family, and a marriage proposal ceremony is held for Mustafa. Serhat also attends the event, not wanting to leave Zeynep alone.  While Cihan continues his collaboration with Nejat, Azra chooses to tell Serhat everything she knows. Learning that Pelin is Nejat's man, Serhat argues with Can. Pelin is baffled by the crisis between the two brothers. Nejat is preparing to strike a heavy blow against Serhat and his family, unaware of Serhat's plan.

episodes.name: Episode 27
episodes.overview: Zeynep confronts Berrak, intensifying the cold war between them as she asks whether she chooses Serhat or Kader. Serhat, with Can's help, continues with his plans regarding Nejat. Zeynep begins to be held captive by the nightmarish memories of her past. Meanwhile, Ebru finds herself in danger once again.  Can and Serhat are trying to catch Nejat's accomplice during a police raid on a shipment that is about to take place at the port. However, an unexpected development delivers a huge shock.

episodes.name: Episode 28
episodes.overview:
The shadow of the past continues to haunt Zeynep, while Serhat, who was shot, is fighting for his life in the hospital.

Will Serhat be able to win this war and return to the woman he loves and his family?

episodes.name: Episode 29
episodes.overview: After Pelin's arrest, Serhat is furious when he learns about Berrak's latest act of cruelty against Zeynep. Pelin is forced to betray Nejat to Serhat. Serhat is very close to learning a life-changing secret from Nejat. However, Nejat is killed when Serhat's father intervenes.  The Tecer family is filled with excitement as Azra's baby's gender is revealed. Zeynep, however, spends her days in fear of facing Sefa at any moment. Ebru and Serhat try to protect Zeynep from danger without letting her know. But Ebru unexpectedly comes face-to-face with Sefa. Will Serhat be able to protect Zeynep and Ebru?

episodes.name: Episode 30
episodes.overview: Arriving at the last moment to save Zeynep and Ebru, Serhat encounters an unexpected scene. Zeynep, terrified of confronting the nightmare she's been living for years, reaches for a knife. Serhat saves Zeynep and Ebru from death. Azra's plans to build a free life for herself without Cihan are thwarted by Cihan's schemes. As Azra struggles to cope with Cihan's traps, she comes close to losing her sanity.  Serhat continues to track down the envelope after Nejat's disappearance, acting meticulously and cautiously before making a major deal. The decision in Kader's custody case causes new chaos for Berrak. Will Zeynep be reunited with Kader? Serhat is shocked when the betrayal he experienced in front of the tabloid press becomes public knowledge.

episodes.name: Episode 31
episodes.overview: Zeynep worries about her wedding preparations being tainted. Hayal makes a shocking decision in the face of a painful revelation. Serhat finds out who leaked the information to the press, and the family is thrown into turmoil once again. As Serhat and Zeynep take steps towards a new life, things don't seem likely to calm down.

episodes.name: Episode 32
episodes.overview: Serhat and Zeynep's wedding turns into a tragedy! Serhat finally meets his father, but things don't go as planned. Zeynep has chosen her wedding dress and is enjoying her bachelorette party. Although Serhat does everything he can to make their wedding perfect, his father's difficult choice will lead Serhat and Zeynep to unexpected places.
